split_policy: Whole matches only. Development may use leave-one-match-out comparisons. Validation is for limited candidate selection. Sealed test requires an explicit release at final model selection.
challenge_usage: Unsupervised inspection and official public correctness checks only; excluded from supervised training and hyperparameter selection.
corruption_note: Stress scenarios are fixed hypotheses, not fitted simulator parameters. Noise depends on inputs and RNG only, never on possession or alive/dead labels. The challenge missing-gap aggregate includes stoppages and cannot be interpreted as live-play occlusion alone.
